disclosures.problem: .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
description: The VSTest artifact postprocessor can consume a forged executionComplete.json from another local user and execute attacker-controlled output handling.
Standalone packages must be updated separately from SDK-bundled VSTest. For releases without a same-line fix, use a compatible fixed servicing line; the listed fixed version is an upgrade target.

disclosures.problem: .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: Managed HttpListener can recursively process an unterminated request line and exhaust the process stack.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Information Disclosure Vulnerability
description: A crafted X-Forwarded-Prefix can inject cookie path delimiters unless PathBase-derived cookie paths percent-encode semicolons.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: Processing comma-separated HTTP header values can cause excessive allocations and resource exhaustion.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
description: The Blazor/SignalR /_blazor/refresh path can accept a cross-site request that binds a victim's authenticated principal to an attacker-owned circuit.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
description: SignalR connections are not consistently bound to the identity negotiated at connection establishment, allowing injected messages to execute Hub invocations as the victim.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: SignalR Redis scale-out can mishandle case-mismatched group removal and leave subscriptions in a state that permits persistent resource amplification and denial of service.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: Multipart form processing can bypass the configured header-count limit and consume excessive resources.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Information Disclosure Vulnerability
description: A reused ResponseBufferingStream can retain pooled tail memory and expose response-body data from another request through HTTP logging.

disclosures.problem: Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description: A crafted PDB LF_DECIMAL payload can trigger an out-of-bounds stack write when processed by DIA.

disclosures.problem: Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description: Attacker-controlled COFF relocation offsets can cause an out-of-bounds stack write in DiaObjectFile::ApplyFixup.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability
description: Malformed chunked HttpSys requests containing conflicting content-length headers can retain request and connection resources.

disclosures.problem: .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
description: Time-of-check time-of-use (toctou) race condition in .NET allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

Windows is outside this advisory's affected scope when its temporary directory is private to the current user, as assumed by the implementation. Shared or insecurely configured Windows temporary directories are not covered by that assumption.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
description: PathString.StartsWithSegments can mishandle percent-encoded backslashes and permit authorization checks to match an unintended path.

disclosures.problem: ASP.NET Core Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
description: Concurrent execution using shared resource with improper synchronization ('race condition') in ASP.NET Core allows an authorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally.

disclosures.problem: Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description: A Portable PDB EmbeddedSource record with parent RID 0 can trigger an out-of-bounds write.

disclosures.problem: Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description: An oversized Portable PDB document name can be truncated during allocation and cause a heap out-of-bounds write.

fixed.description: Additional SDK-template and standalone Identity UI fixes

description: ASP.NET Core Identity password-reset and confirmation flows can send mail to the unvalidated request address instead of the user's stored canonical address.
This update also covers Identity UI and Blazor template paths. Updating a runtime, SDK, or template package does not rewrite application source that was generated previously.
